steps: Reader transcribes the photograph and Prover algebraically calculates the key features of y = x^2 - 2x - 8.
Designer generates tactile print files for the parabola, vertex, and axis intercepts.
Sonifier converts the graph's curve into an interactive sound and tactile-audio layout.
Explainer writes audio descriptions in English and isiZulu, plus a plain-language guide for Deaf learners.
Reviewer conducts a final quality check across all tactile, audio, and written outputs.
